desc: Implement directional parity DP with per-direction prefix lengths and clockwise suffix run lengths.
Define the four directed diagonal directions and their clockwise mapping.
Compute suffix run-length tables for alternating 0/2 runs in each possible turn direction.
Compute prefix lengths for valid straight diagonal segments starting from 1 in each direction.
Combine each valid prefix with the clockwise outgoing suffix run length to update the V-shaped answer without double-counting the turn cell.
Handle edge cases: no 1, single-cell segments, boundaries, immediate turns, and straight segments longer than V-shaped segments.
Run the current implementation against the four provided sample tests and report a SAMPLE TESTS verdict.
If any sample test fails, diagnose the failing case and fix the implementation or switch to an alternative approach.
